evidence_zh: 113 个国家和地区；海外门店 3,644 家（2026 年 6 月）

evidence_en: Retail stores in 20 countries; 221 overseas stores (Jun 2026)
evidence_zh: 门店覆盖 20 个国家；海外门店 221 家（2026 年 6 月）

evidence_en: 16 overseas countries, but ~83% of overseas stores were in Indonesia + Vietnam (Sep 2024)
evidence_zh: 海外 16 国，但约 83% 海外门店集中在印尼和越南（2024 年 9 月）

evidence_en: Low-price staple drinks; no single product line drives the business
evidence_zh: 平价日常饮品，没有单一爆品撑业绩

evidence_en: Wide everyday assortment; IP collaborations help but no single IP is disclosed as a large share
evidence_zh: 日用品类宽，IP 联名有拉动，但没有单一 IP 占比过高

evidence_en: THE MONSTERS (LABUBU) = 38% of FY2025 revenue; overseas revenue fell 11.1% in 1H2026 as it cooled
evidence_zh: THE MONSTERS（LABUBU）占 2025 年收入 38%；热度回落后 2026 上半年海外收入下滑 11.1%

evidence_en: 78% of overseas stores run by retail partners or distributors; direct share rising (22%)
evidence_zh: 78% 海外门店由合伙人或代理商经营；直营占比在升（22%）

evidence_en: Overseas stores are mainly self-operated, so the company carries rent and fit-out
evidence_zh: 海外门店以自营为主，租金和装修由公司承担

evidence_en: 1H2026 overseas revenue +14.9%, but same-store GMV down low-single digits; plans a net cut of 50-70 overseas stores in 2H
evidence_zh: 2026 上半年海外收入 +14.9%，但同店 GMV 低个位数下滑；下半年计划海外净减 50-70 家店

evidence_en: 1H2026 overseas revenue -11.1% (first decline) while overseas stores grew 73%
evidence_zh: 2026 上半年海外收入 -11.1%（首次下滑），海外门店却增长 73%

evidence_en: Overseas stores -7.5% YoY to 4,378; third straight half-year decline
evidence_zh: 海外门店同比 -7.5% 至 4,378 家，连续三个半年下降

evidence_en: Edge = China supply chain + fast product curation + staged entry (distributor, partner, direct); needs no hit
evidence_zh: 核心是中国供应链 + 快速选品 + 分阶段进入（代理、合伙人、直营），不靠爆款

evidence_en: Supply chain + franchising is learnable, but needs store density and local warehouses (9 countries so far)
evidence_zh: 供应链 + 加盟可学，但需要门店密度和本地仓（目前 9 国）

evidence_en: Edge = creating hit IP; the playbook is visible, the result is hard to repeat
evidence_zh: 核心是做出爆款 IP；方法看得见，结果难复制
